exercises.prompt: Połącz zwroty z tłumaczeniem.
answer: It's set in...|Akcja dzieje się w...
The best thing about it is...|Najlepsze jest...

exercises.prompt: The film is ___ a girl who travels back in time.
The story is very ___. I knew the ending after ten minutes.
The film is ___ in New York in the 1920s. (akcja dzieje się)
I'd definitely ___ it to anyone who likes comedies. (polecić)
Ułóż recenzję.
answer: Last weekend I watched the new Polish comedy, Wakacje.
It's about a family who win a holiday in Spain.
The actors are brilliant, but the ending is a bit predictable.
I'd recommend it to anyone who wants to laugh.
